title: 第2258章 黑市拍卖行第2257章 青色葫芦
content_zh:
数月时间，转瞬即逝。
青山宗外门，叶无尘所在的院落当中。
叶无尘盘坐在石床上，双目微闭，周身隐隐有灵光流转，将他整个人笼罩在一片朦胧的光晕之中。
这数月来，他一直在潜心修行，日子过得倒也充实，体内的仙力也已经饱满，随时都有可能突破仙尊境界。
“按照这个速度，最多再有一个月，我就能突破到仙尊境了。”
叶无尘睁开眼睛，那双深邃的眸子中闪过一丝精芒。
一旦突破到仙尊境，他便可以再次踏入青冥塔，挑战第九层。
第九层中究竟有什么，他很是期待。
而就在此时，院门外忽然传来一阵急促的敲门声，伴随着一道清脆如铃的声音。
“叶无尘！叶无尘！快开门！”
叶无尘的眉头微微皱起，他听出了这个声音。
洛云汐。
这丫头怎么又来了？
他起身走到院门前，伸手拉开院门。
只见洛云汐今日穿了一件淡紫色的短裙，露出两截白皙纤细的小腿，腰间那串铃铛叮当作响，两条俏皮的辫子在身后一甩一甩的，整个人看起来活力四射。
此刻她正站在院门外，双手叉腰，仰着脑袋，一双灵动的眸子中满是兴奋。
“你怎么来了？”叶无尘靠在门框上，神色淡然。
“怎么，看起来你好像很不开心嘛。”洛云汐瞪了他一眼，理直气壮道，“本小姐来找你，那是看得起你，你这是什么态度！”
“有什么事？”叶无尘懒得跟她斗嘴，直接问道。
洛云汐嘿嘿一笑，凑上前来，压低声音道：“你知道黑市拍卖行吗？”

叶无尘眉头微挑，摇了摇头。
“黑市拍卖行，是青天域最大的地下拍卖行，每三年举办一次，拍卖的都是些市面上见不到的宝贝！”洛云汐越说越兴奋，那双灵动的眸子中闪烁着光芒，“丹药、功法、法宝、灵药、妖兽材料，应有尽有，甚至听说还有天帝境强者留下的传承！”
“跟我有什么关系？”叶无尘依旧靠在门框上，神色平淡。
“你这人怎么一点好奇心都没有！”洛云汐跺了跺脚，腰间铃铛叮当作响，“黑市拍卖行离我青山宗不过并不算多远，我们一起去看看嘛！”
“不去。”叶无尘干脆利落地拒绝。
“为什么？”
“没钱。”
洛云汐愣了愣，随即拍了拍胸脯，一副财大气粗的模样：“没钱怕什么，本小姐有钱！看上什么尽管跟本小姐说，本小姐帮你买！”
叶无尘上下打量了她一眼，目光中带着几分怀疑。
“你有钱？”
上次这丫头说给五百上品灵晶作为报酬，结果连一百都拿不出来，最后还是靠偷灵药抵账。
“你那是什么眼神！”洛云汐被他看得有些不自在，干咳两声，梗着脖子道，“本小姐最近发财了，手里宽裕得很！”
“怎么发的财？”叶无尘问道。
“这个……”洛云汐眼神飘忽，支支吾吾，“你就别管了，反正我有钱就是了！”
content_en:
Months passed in a blink of an eye.
At the outer gate of Qingshan Sect, in the courtyard where Ye Wuchen is.
Ye Wuchen sat cross-legged on the stone bed, his eyes slightly closed, and there was a faint spiritual light flowing around him, shrouding his whole body in a hazy halo.
Over the past few months, he has been practicing with great concentration, and his life has been fulfilling. The immortal power in his body is also full, and he may break through to the immortal realm at any time.
"At this rate, I will be able to break through to the Immortal Realm in another month at most."
Ye Wuchen opened his eyes, and a glimmer of light flashed in his deep eyes.
Once he breaks through to the Immortal Realm, he can step into the Qingming Tower again and challenge the ninth floor.
He was looking forward to what was on the ninth floor.
At this moment, there was a sudden knock on the door, accompanied by a sound as clear as a bell.
"Ye Wuchen! Ye Wuchen! Open the door quickly!"
Ye Wuchen's brows wrinkled slightly as he heard the voice.
Luo Yunxi.
Why is this girl here again?
He stood up and walked to the courtyard door, stretched out his hand and opened the door.
Luo Yunxi was seen wearing a lavender short skirt today, revealing two fair and slender legs. The string of bells around her waist jingled, and her two playful braids were swaying behind her. She looked full of energy.
At this moment, she was standing outside the courtyard gate, with her hands on her hips and her head raised, her smart eyes full of excitement.
"Why are you here?" Ye Wuchen leaned against the door frame with an indifferent expression.
"Why, you seem to be very unhappy." Luo Yunxi glared at him and said confidently, "I came to you because I think highly of you. What kind of attitude do you have!"
"What's the matter?" Ye Wuchen didn't bother to argue with her and asked directly.
Luo Yunxi chuckled, stepped forward, and lowered her voice: "Do you know about the black market auction house?"
Ye Wuchen raised his eyebrows slightly and shook his head.
"The Black Market Auction House is the largest underground auction house in the Qingtian Territory. It is held every three years. The auctions are all treasures that cannot be seen on the market!" Luo Yunxi became more and more excited as she spoke, her smart eyes flashing with light. "Elixirs, techniques, magic weapons, elixirs, monster materials, everything is available. I even heard that there are inheritances left by powerful people in the Heavenly Emperor realm!"
"What does it have to do with me?" Ye Wuchen was still leaning against the door frame with a calm expression.
"Why don't you have any curiosity at all!" Luo Yunxi stamped her feet and jingled the bell on her waist, "The black market auction house is not that far away from my Qingshan Sect. Let's go and have a look together!"
"I won't go." Ye Wuchen simply refused.
"Why?"
"No money."
Luo Yunxi was stunned for a moment, then she patted her chest and said with a wealthy look: "If you don't have money, there's nothing to be afraid of. I have money! Just tell me what you like and I'll help you buy it!"
Ye Wuchen looked her up and down, with some suspicion in his eyes.
"Are you rich?"
Last time, this girl offered to give five hundred high-grade spiritual crystals as a reward, but she couldn't even get one hundred, so she ended up stealing spiritual elixirs to pay off the debt.
"What's that look in your eyes!" Luo Yunxi felt a little uncomfortable when he looked at her. She coughed twice and said with a pinched neck, "I have made a fortune recently, and I have a lot of money!"
"How did you get rich?" Ye Wuchen asked.
"This..." Luo Yunxi's eyes wandered and he hesitated, "Just leave it alone, as long as I have money anyway!"
